snippet.title: Dementium II OUT NOW on Steam!
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5342930/Dementium_II/

The original Dementium II, restored by the team who made it. William Redmoor wakes with fresh staples in his skull inside an asylum for the criminally insane, where the walls peel back to reveal something worse. Fight, solve and survive the cult DS horror classic, now on PC.
